titleEnglish: Naseeb Mera Jaga Diya — Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan

verses.ar:
Banayi mujh benawah ki bigri, naseeb mera jaga diya
Tere karam pe nisaar tu ne mujhe bhi jeena sikha diya
verses.en:
You mended the life of this destitute, awakened my dormant fate
I am indebted to your grace; you have taught me how to live as well

verses.ar: Banayi mujh benawah ki bigri, naseeb mera jaga diya
verses.en: You mended the life of this destitute, awakened my dormant fate

verses.ar: Tere karam pe nisaar tu ne mujhe bhi jeena sikha diya
verses.en: I am indebted to your grace; you have taught me how to live as well

verses.ar: Badal gayi mere dil ki dunya, aata ne wo martaba diya
verses.en: The world of my heart has changed; the blessings have granted me such a stature

verses.ar: Karam ki aise nigaah dali, gadaa ko sultaan bana diya
verses.en: With such a gracious glance, a beggar was turned into a king

verses.ar: Karam ke saaye mein hum ko rakha, kabhi hirasa na hum hue
verses.en: Kept us under the shade of grace, never did we feel any fear

verses.ar: Hamare sir pe jo dhoop aayi to apna daaman barha diya
verses.en: When the sun blazed over our heads, you extended your garment to shield us

verses.ar: Yeh inki banda-nawazian hein, jo mujh pe aisa karam keya
verses.en: It is their kindness to servants that bestowed such grace upon me

verses.ar: Bana ke apna faqeer mujh ko, gham e jahaan se chura liya
verses.en: By making me their humble devotee, they rescued me from the sorrows of the world

verses.ar: Wuzoo keya mein ne aasman se, namaaz meri adaa howi
verses.en: I performed ablution with water from the heavens, and my prayer was fulfilled

verses.ar: Mila jo naqsh e kadam tumhara, to mein ne sir ko jhuka liya
verses.en: When I found the imprint of your footsteps, I bowed my head in reverence

verses.ar: Kisi ko dar se na khaali taala, her ik sawali ko bheek di
verses.en: No one left the door empty-handed; every seeker was granted alms

verses.ar: Ghareeb aaye jo aastan pe, karam ka darya bahaa diya
verses.en: When the poor came to the threshold, a river of grace was made to flow

verses.ar: Ghareeb dar dar bhatak rahay thay, kaheen na dil ko sukoon mila
verses.en: The poor wandered from door to door, finding no peace for the heart

verses.ar: Karam kiya tu ne apne dar ko hamara kaaba bana diya
verses.en: You graced us by making your threshold our sanctuary, our Kaaba
